maximum_defensible_paper_wording: In the evaluated UAV-swarm reconfiguration scenarios, safety-aware planning reduced predictable nominal conflict, realized hard-risk exposure, and the corrective burden left to feedback in the registered structural- and mixed-risk families. The frozen experiment did not show that reactive feedback reduced residual realized hard-risk exposure in the registered residual-risk family, so the full planning-execution responsibility decomposition is only partially supported.
